note: The raw fuzzer input is decoded as a UA_Variant JSON value.
The input Type field selects the Variant body type; the PoC uses Type 22, ExtensionObject.
Because the body type is ExtensionObject, the Body object is passed to the unwrapping decoder with the Variant as destination.
The nested TypeId object is decoded to a NodeId; the PoC uses Id 785, which resolves to CreateSubscriptionRequest.
Memory is allocated for the decoded CreateSubscriptionRequest body and stored directly in the Variant.
The Body field is decoded into the allocated CreateSubscriptionRequest object.

code: ret = decodeFields(ctx, parseCtx, entries, membersSize, type);
note: The malformed Body object drives nested structure decoding far enough to allocate inner NodeId-owned data and then return an error.
On decode failure, the allocated structured body is freed without clearing nested members and without nulling the Variant data pointer.
The failed top-level decode asks the Variant cleanup path to clear the same Variant after its data pointer has already been freed.
Variant cleanup treats the dangling data pointer as a scalar array of the selected structured type.
Structure cleanup walks fields inside the freed CreateSubscriptionRequest allocation.
NodeId_clear reads the identifier type from the already-freed structure allocation, matching the heap-use-after-free crash state.
